data: Bundled Sakila SQLite; source pinned in build.gradle.kts
policy: Do not tune Skills using this suite before the first comparison. Once used for tuning, label it regression. Known Sakila schema; not an unseen-database benchmark.

queries.sql: SELECT c.store_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.customer_id) AS paying_customers, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE p.payment_date >= '2005-07-01' AND p.payment_date < '2005-08-01' GROUP BY c.store_id ORDER BY c.store_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount),0),2) AS revenue FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2099-01-01' AND payment_date < '2100-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN email IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(email) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_email, SUM(CASE WHEN email IS NULL OR TRIM(email) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_email FROM customer
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rentals FROM rental
SELECT COUNT(*) AS affected_customers FROM customer WHERE active <> 0
